title: Delivery Claims Types and the Starting Figure of Marlowe Rewards Goodwill
content:
The starting figure of a Marlowe Rewards service goodwill grant depends on the type of the approved claim under Delivery Claims. For some claim types it also depends on the points the affected order holds.

## Net points the affected order holds

The affected order is the order the approved claim was opened on. Its net points are the sum of the points on every points entry recorded for that order: its earning entries and its reversal entries together. The net points are never taken below zero.

## Starting figure by claim type

| Type of the approved claim | Starting figure |
|---|---|
| Damaged in Transit Claim, Missing Item Claim, Wrong Item Claim | twice (2 times) the net points the affected order holds, but no more than the per-case goodwill allowance of the tier held on the posting date |
| Late Delivery Claim | the net points the affected order holds, but no more than that per-case goodwill allowance |
| Any other claim type: Delivered Not Received Claim, Lost in Transit Claim | the per-case goodwill allowance of the tier held on the posting date |

## Worked cases (hypothetical ledgers and a hypothetical per-case allowance of 400 points)

| Points entries recorded for the affected order | Net points | Claim type | Starting figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| earning 180, reversal minus 60 | 120 | Damaged in Transit Claim | 240 |
| earning 180, reversal minus 60 | 120 | Late Delivery Claim | 120 |
| earning 300 | 300 | Wrong Item Claim | 400 (twice 300 is 600, held to 400) |
| earning 50, reversal minus 80 | 0 (minus 30 is not used) | Missing Item Claim | 0 |
| earning 180 | 180 | Lost in Transit Claim | 400 |
